purpose: Compile believable Naruto Classic character behavior before prose; bots are evidence providers, not prose authorities.

stages.name: Memory ASBE
does: ENACT memory as changed behavior, never exposition

stages.name: Reference Triangulation
does: extract decision patterns and frequency, not quotes

stages.name: Behavior Frequency Ledger
does: track repetition count in current sequence

stages.name: Addressing / Honorific Gate v33
does: apply directional relation before generic hierarchy
preserve teacher/Kage titles when the reference and relation support them
preserve stable peer suffixes such as -kun/-san only in licensed relationships
allow urgency to compress titles without automatically erasing respect
select one consistent PT-BR/Japanese surface for the scene

stages.name: Reference Essence Gate v34
does: load the actor's exact official reference character(s) and the phase named by source_anchor
extract dominant core, social surface, combat-pressure behavior, break trigger, body/voice signature and anti-regression
apply only documented transfer axes; never average all references blindly
let reboot dossier, live relationship, legitimate knowledge and body state outrank generic reference traits
under a trigger, use the reference's actual break behavior rather than preserving artificial calm
for mixed references, use primary anchor first and secondary references only for explicitly mapped axes

stages.name: Technique Research + Impression Gate v35
does: whenever a named jutsu is declared, research/verify canonical name, rank, nature, range/shape, exact hand seals, known users, canonical demonstrations, limitations/counters and access/rarity status before narrating exact mechanics
separate canonical technique mechanics from the current user's execution scale; Madara-level output does not transfer automatically
calculate observer impression from rank + rarity + prestige + execution difficulty + visible scale + chakra burden + expectation violation + observer knowledge/familiarity
track threat/fear separately from astonishment; being impressed does not force panic
resolve recognition per observer knowledge channel; a novice may be stunned by scale without knowing the name, while an expert may identify difficulty with little outward reaction
apply experience/composure mainly to outward reaction, not to objective recognition of an extraordinary feat
select only materially relevant spectator reactions; never create a reaction queue

stages.name: Exact-Phase Oral Fingerprint Gate v39
does: prefer exact-phase source rhythm over polished sentence completeness
allow fragments, grunts, interruptions, omissions, abrupt topic shifts and silence when supported
reject symmetrical banter, tidy punchline chains, narrator analysis in dialogue and trailer aphorisms
Jiraiya-like: alternate loud/energetic surface with lazy brush-offs, teasing, complaints, silence and sudden competence
Tsunade-like: blunt technical authority, reluctant respect, compressed anger; no lecture by default
mental read-aloud in PT-BR; reject translated-English syntax and English leakage

stages.name: Contrastive Decision Set
does: reject options based on catchphrase imitation or wrong threshold

stages.name: Parallel Agenda Scheduler
does: keep every relevant NPC agenda active

stages.name: Performance Realization
does: apply Reference Essence v34 before final dialogue/body realization
body and voice from same impulse
apply addressing/honorific plan v33 before final wording

stages.name: Destructive Verification
does: reference essence / phase / break-trigger regression test

stages.name: Player Window
does: preserve simultaneous causal state for next turn

behavior_frequency_ledger.typical: Default under matching conditions; may still be suppressed by pressure/relation.
behavior_frequency_ledger.possible: Allowed only when a specific trigger/goal justifies it.
behavior_frequency_ledger.rare: Needs strong contextual trigger and should not recur casually.
behavior_frequency_ledger.forbidden: Contradicts phase, relation, knowledge, repertoire, or established characterization.

contrastive_decision_rule: At important beats compare at least: silence/body-only; minimal functional response; active relational response. Choose by objective + threshold + reference decision pattern, not by stylistic resemblance.
research_rule: Search 'how X reacts to Y when Z happens' in the correct phase. Extract behavioral evidence, thresholds and frequency. Never search only 'personality of X' when a relation-specific decision matters.
narrator_rule: Prefer observable action -> body/perception -> necessary speech -> immediate consequence. Internal thought only when focalization truly warrants it.
combat_rule: position -> named-technique research gate -> simultaneous intentions -> perception -> timing/hand-seal telegraph -> response attempt -> collision -> consequence -> impression/threat update -> next actionable window.
anti_patterns: narrator explains recognition that body can show
possible behavior used at constant frequency
blanket honorific suffixes as anime decoration
stable relational suffix erased without trigger
reference character reduced to one adjective while its break triggers disappear
later/adult phase personality imported into Chunin/Part I anchor
mixed-reference character receives all traits from all references at once
triggered character remains generically calm against canonical break behavior

canonical_examples.Saya Haruno→Kazuma Uzumaki: Kazuma-kun is the ordinary direct-address default in the early Sakura→Sasuke-like invested relation; bare Kazuma needs urgency, sharp irritation, or live relationship change.
canonical_examples.Saya Haruno→Kagetsu Shiranui: Kagetsu-sensei in ordinary safe address; sensei! is valid compression under urgency.
canonical_examples.Sakura/Ino-like→Kage: deferential Kage title; do not default to bare personal name.
canonical_examples.Hinata-like invested peer: -kun can be stable when that exact relationship is mapped.

anti_patterns: bare-name teacher/Kage from a hierarchy-sensitive character without a trigger

reference_essence_gate_v34.rule: Reference characters are acting mechanics, not vague inspiration. Exact phase matters. Reboot biography/powers/plot remain separate.

examples.Yoshiro Sabaku: Gaara Chunin baseline silence + ruthlessness; own blood/pain/defense breach can break into shouting, disturbed laughter/grin, trembling and violent fixation. No Kazekage maturity.
examples.Sayo Sabaku: Temari Chunin blunt confidence, deboche, tactical sharpness and cruel edge; real caution around unstable Yoshiro.
examples.Kuroto Sabaku: Kankuro Chunin cocky/irritable puppeteer, rough hostility and fear of provoking Yoshiro.
examples.Saya Haruno: Sakura early social adaptation: authority respect, Kazuma filter, Amatsu explosiveness, insecurity/protectiveness under pressure.
examples.Kaede/Kazuma: Sasuke early economy/pride; affection leaks through action; competence/family triggers sharpen rather than produce adult speeches.

technique_research_impression_gate_v35.trigger: any declared named jutsu when exact mechanics or reactions matter
core_rules: one-hand-seal or short-sequence casting changes telegraph/timing but does not itself raise rank
legendary known user association only matters to an observer who legitimately knows that association
clan-restricted or reserved access raises prestige only when that status is established in canon/reboot evidence
large chakra cost becomes especially impressive when the observer understands the user's age/reserve/fatigue and prior expenditures
an unknown technique can still produce high visual astonishment from scale; exact identification remains blocked
do not force all spectators to speak

final_checks: Would this exact-phase reference speak this much, this neatly and this explicitly?
No internal English prompt/evidence wording leaks into final PT-BR.
Technical observation is not automatically verbalized; body/silence/narration may carry it.
Banter may end asymmetrically; do not manufacture balanced callbacks.
